fr.efficiency_note: l'eau n'est réutilisée qu'à l'intérieur d'une bassine : il faut donc plusieurs fois la charge d'une machine pour la même vaisselle, et l'écart entre un lavage soigneux et un lavage négligent est considérable
fr.choose_if: vous ne voulez ni appareil ni électricité, et voulez une eau de rinçage pour le jardin.

solutions.name: Living toilet (urine-diverting, larvae-processed)
solutions.summary: A dry toilet that separates urine and lets fly larvae eat the solids inside its own bin. In days rather than months, the larvae turn the waste into a fine, odourless material. It suits a flat, where there is nowhere to compost, but the larvae slow down in a cold room.

ratings.build_note: two opaque boxes, breathable mesh, battens and sawdust; the tutorial rates the bin at 45 minutes and about 10 EUR before the larvae

solutions.choose_if: you live in a flat with nowhere to compost and want waste turned odourless in days.
solutions.lifespan: The larvae bin is the wearing part and the rest is joinery. The Boulogne-Billancourt build used a PLA bin that cracked at the folds inside the four months; the report's own recommendation is stainless steel, which would outlast the toilet around it
solutions.site_prerequisites: A room that stays above roughly 20 C, or the larvae go dormant and the bin stops working. The experiment saw exactly that in October. A separate container for the diverted urine, and somewhere for the finished substrate to go. No plumbing, no drain and no supply, but the bin sets the fixture's footprint rather than the pan: in the flat it ran, the bin's length decided where the toilet could be, and it ended up next to the kitchen
solutions.regulation_fr: Dry toilets are explicitly permitted (arrete du 7 septembre 2009 modifie) but must be declared to the SPANC, and byproducts must be composted on the property without discharge or nuisance to neighbours. In a flat that last condition is the whole difficulty, and it is what this design answers: the transformation happens inside the bin rather than in a heap outdoors. Where the substrate finally goes is still the household's problem to solve

tutorials.title: Sciences Participatives : Toilettes vivantes
tutorials.line: Citizen science: a living toilet

sources.name: Low-tech Lab wiki, Sciences Participatives : Toilettes vivantes (Biosphere Experience citizen-science programme, 699 trials Sept-Oct 2024)
Rapport Biosphere Urbaine (Biosphere Experience), four-month apartment experiment, Boulogne-Billancourt 2024

fr.name: Toilettes vivantes (à séparation d'urine, traitées par les larves)
fr.description: Des toilettes sèches qui séparent l’urine et laissent des larves de mouche manger les matières dans leur propre bac. En quelques jours plutôt qu’en plusieurs mois, les larves transforment les déchets en une matière fine et sans odeur. Elles conviennent à un appartement, où l’on ne peut pas composter, mais les larves ralentissent dans une pièce froide.
fr.lifespan: Le bac à larves est la pièce d'usure, le reste est de la menuiserie. La réalisation de Boulogne-Billancourt utilisait un bac en PLA qui s'est fissuré aux pliures en quatre mois ; le rapport recommande lui-même l'inox, qui survivrait à la toilette qui l'entoure
fr.site_prerequisites: Une pièce qui reste au-dessus de 20 C environ, sans quoi les larves entrent en dormance et le bac cesse de fonctionner : l'expérience l'a constaté dès octobre. Un récipient séparé pour l'urine détournée, et une destination pour le substrat fini. Ni plomberie, ni évacuation, ni alimentation, mais c'est le bac et non la cuvette qui fixe l'encombrement : dans l'appartement concerné, sa longueur a décidé de l'emplacement des toilettes, qui ont fini à côté de la cuisine
fr.build_note: deux boîtes opaques, un textile respirant, des tasseaux et de la sciure ; le tutoriel annonce 45 minutes et une dizaine d'euros pour le bac, larves non comprises
fr.regulation_fr: Les toilettes sèches sont expressément autorisées (arrêté du 7 septembre 2009 modifié) mais doivent être déclarées au SPANC, et les sous-produits compostés sur la parcelle, sans rejet ni nuisance pour le voisinage. En appartement, cette dernière condition est toute la difficulté, et c'est précisément ce à quoi ce dispositif répond : la transformation a lieu dans le bac et non dans un tas à l'extérieur. Reste à savoir où part le substrat une fois mûr, et cela demeure le problème du foyer
fr.choose_if: vous vivez en appartement sans endroit pour composter et voulez des déchets rendus inodores en quelques jours.

solutions.name: Misting shower
solutions.summary: A shower that wets the body with a fine mist instead of a stream, fed by a small tank of very hot water. A mist covers the skin with a fraction of the water, so a whole shower takes 2 to 5 litres instead of 60 to 80, and far less energy. It takes longer, and ends cold when the tank runs out.

ratings.build_note: misters and tubing onto an enclosure that already exists; the tutorial's two-day estimate is almost entirely the insulated tank
ratings.efficiency_note: The measured 2 to 5 litres a shower is below the recirculating row's own published figure, so on the numbers alone this would rank first. It does not, because that is one four-month installation against a manufacturer's claim, and neither is a test standard. The sub-function's basis places mist second and it stays there; if a measured comparison ever appears, this is the row to revisit

solutions.choose_if: you want the least water and energy of any shower, for little money.
solutions.lifespan: The misters are the wearing part: they block with scale in hard water, unscrew and cost very little. The tank is a water heater and lasts like one
solutions.site_prerequisites: A pressurised feed, because a mist needs pressure that a gravity tank will not give. A drain and a sloped floor or tray. Nothing structural is touched, so it goes into an existing enclosure

tutorials.line: Full build: a water- and energy-saving shower

tutorials.title: Sciences Participatives : La douche à brumisation
tutorials.line: Citizen science: a misting shower

tutorial_lines_fr.https://wiki.lowtechlab.org/wiki/Biosph%: Fabrication complète : une douche économe en eau et en énergie
tutorial_lines_fr.https://wiki.lowtechlab.org/wiki/Science: Sciences participatives : une douche à brumisation

sources.name: Low-tech Lab wiki, Biosphere Urbaine : La douche econome en eau et en energie
Low-tech Lab wiki, Sciences Participatives : La douche a brumisation

fr.name: Douche brumisante
fr.description: Une douche qui mouille le corps d’une fine brume au lieu d’un jet, alimentée par un petit réservoir d’eau très chaude. La brume couvre la peau avec une fraction de l’eau : une douche complète prend 2 à 5 litres au lieu de 60 à 80, et bien moins d’énergie. Elle dure plus longtemps et finit froide quand le réservoir est vide.
fr.lifespan: Les brumisateurs sont la pièce d'usure : ils s'entartrent en eau dure, se dévissent et coûtent très peu. Le ballon est un chauffe-eau et dure comme tel
fr.site_prerequisites: Une alimentation sous pression, car une brume exige une pression qu'un réservoir gravitaire ne donnera pas. Une évacuation et un sol en pente ou un receveur. Rien de structurel n'est touché : cela s'installe dans une cabine existante
fr.build_note: des brumisateurs et des tuyaux sur une cabine qui existe déjà ; les deux jours annoncés par le tutoriel sont presque entièrement consacrés au ballon isolé
fr.efficiency_note: Les 2 à 5 litres mesurés par douche sont inférieurs au chiffre publié par la douche à recirculation : sur les seuls nombres, cette fiche serait première. Elle ne l'est pas, parce qu'il s'agit d'une installation unique suivie quatre mois face à une annonce de fabricant, et qu'aucune des deux n'est un essai normalisé. La base de la sous-fonction place la brumisation en deuxième et elle y reste ; si une comparaison mesurée paraît un jour, c'est cette fiche qu'il faudra revoir
fr.choose_if: vous voulez la douche qui consomme le moins d’eau et d’énergie, pour peu d’argent.

solutions.name: Box-bed with thermal curtain
solutions.summary: A bed enclosed like a cupboard, closed with a curtain in cold weather. Only the small space around the sleeper needs to stay warm, and their own body heat does it, with no heater. The bedroom can stay cool all night, and the enclosed bed is also dark and quiet.

ratings.build_note: a frame and a curtain; carpentry rather than a system

solutions.choose_if: you want to sleep warm, in the dark and quiet, in an unheated bedroom.
solutions.lifespan: Joinery, so it lasts as long as the furniture does. The one failure reported was the mattress rather than the bed: hemp wool compacted over a few weeks and had to be re-lofted
solutions.site_prerequisites: Floor area for the alcove and enough headroom to sit up in it. Nothing is fixed to the building's structure, which is what puts it within reach of a tenant as well as an owner

tutorials.title: Construct a Cozy Hideaway with These Built-In Bed Plans
tutorials.line: Plans: a built-in bed

sources.name: Rapport Biosphere Urbaine (Biosphere Experience), four-month apartment experiment, Boulogne-Billancourt 2024

fr.name: Lit-clos à rideau isolant
fr.description: Un lit fermé comme une armoire, clos par un rideau par temps froid. Seul le petit volume autour du dormeur doit rester chaud, et sa propre chaleur y suffit, sans chauffage. La chambre peut rester fraîche toute la nuit, et le lit clos est aussi sombre et silencieux.
fr.lifespan: De la menuiserie : cela dure aussi longtemps que le meuble. La seule défaillance rapportée concerne le matelas et non le lit, la laine de chanvre s'étant tassée en quelques semaines et ayant dû être regonflée
fr.site_prerequisites: De la surface au sol pour l'alcôve et assez de hauteur pour s'y asseoir. Rien n'est fixé à la structure du bâtiment, ce qui le met à la portée d'un locataire autant que d'un propriétaire
fr.build_note: un cadre et un rideau ; de la menuiserie, pas un système
fr.choose_if: vous voulez dormir au chaud, dans le noir et le calme, dans une chambre non chauffée.

solutions.name: Shared solar terrace
solutions.summary: A shared rooftop or terrace in a block of flats set aside for solar equipment: a cooker, an oven, a dryer. Households with no sunny outdoor space get somewhere to leave things in the sun for hours. The cost of the equipment is shared among the building.

ratings.build_note: nothing is built; a surface is allocated and then equipped

solutions.choose_if: you live in a block of flats and want a sunny place for solar equipment, with the cost shared.
solutions.lifespan: As long as the terrace itself. What stands on it has its own rows and its own lifespans
solutions.site_prerequisites: An accessible flat outdoor surface with clear sky to the south for most of the day, and a building prepared to allocate it. The second is the real prerequisite: the technical bar here is nearly nothing and the collective decision is the whole of the difficulty
solutions.regulation_fr: In a French coproprieté, giving over common area (a roof, a shared terrace) to equipment is a decision of the assemblée générale, whatever the technique and however modest. That vote, not the hardware, is what this solution actually costs.

sources.name: Rapport Biosphere Urbaine (Biosphere Experience), four-month apartment experiment, Boulogne-Billancourt 2024

fr.name: Terrasse solaire partagée
fr.description: Un toit ou une terrasse partagés dans un immeuble, réservés à des équipements solaires : cuiseur, four, séchoir. Les foyers sans espace extérieur ensoleillé ont un endroit où laisser des choses au soleil pendant des heures. Le coût des équipements est partagé par tout l’immeuble.
fr.lifespan: Aussi longtemps que la terrasse. Ce qui s'y installe relève d'autres fiches et d'autres durées de vie
fr.site_prerequisites: Une surface extérieure plane et accessible, dégagée vers le sud une grande partie de la journée, et un immeuble disposé à l'attribuer. C'est le second point le vrai prérequis : la barrière technique est presque nulle et la décision collective fait toute la difficulté
fr.build_note: rien n'est construit : une surface est attribuée puis équipée
fr.regulation_fr: Dans une copropriété, affecter une partie commune (un toit, une terrasse partagée) à des équipements relève d'une décision de l'assemblée générale, quelle que soit la technique et si modeste soit-elle. C'est ce vote, et non le matériel, qui constitue le vrai coût de cette solution
fr.choose_if: vous vivez en immeuble et voulez un endroit ensoleillé pour des équipements solaires, au coût partagé.

solutions.name: Vault or dome shell (walls and roof in one)
solutions.summary: A building whose walls curve over to form the roof, as one self-supporting shell of earth: a Nubian vault of sun-dried bricks, a vault of compressed earth blocks, or a dome of earth-filled bags. No timber or metal roof is needed. In a wet climate the earth must be kept dry, by a render renewed every few years or a roof over it.

ratings.build_note: a self-supporting earth shell, laid without formwork

solutions.choose_if: you want a whole building in earth, with no timber or metal needed for the roof.
solutions.lifespan: About 50 years expected for a Nubian vault, against under 10 for the metal-roofed earth houses it replaces (Wikipédia); unstabilised earth walls in a wet continental climate have an extrapolated lifetime of more than 60 years (Bui et al. 2009), provided the shell's render is kept up.
solutions.site_prerequisites: Suitable earth on site, and a plan for keeping the shell dry: in a wet climate its protective render has to be renewed every few years, or a roof built over it.
solutions.regulation_fr: Part of the structure or footprint: covered by the building permit (permis de construire) for a new dwelling. Rural sites are additionally constrained by the commune's PLU zoning, outside a constructible zone, a new dwelling is generally refused.

tutorials.title: Superadobe
tutorials.line: Full build: a superadobe structure

tutorial_lines_fr.https://wiki.lowtechlab.org/wiki/Superad: Fabrication complète : une construction en superadobe

sources.name: Auroville Earth Institute, "Vaulted structures" - vaults and domes of compressed stabilised earth blocks built without formwork
Bui, Morel, Venkatarama Reddy and Ghayad, "Durability of rammed earth walls exposed for 20 years to natural weathering", Building and Environment 44(5), 912-919, 2009

fr.name: Voûte ou dôme autoportant (murs et toit d’un seul tenant)
fr.description: Un bâtiment dont les murs se referment pour former le toit, en une seule coque de terre autoportante : voûte nubienne en briques séchées au soleil, voûte en blocs de terre comprimée, ou dôme de sacs remplis de terre. Pas besoin de charpente ni de couverture métallique. Sous un climat humide, la terre doit rester au sec, avec un enduit renouvelé régulièrement ou un toit par-dessus.
fr.lifespan: Environ 50 ans d’espérance de vie pour une voûte nubienne, contre moins de 10 pour les maisons en terre à toit de tôle qu’elle remplace (Wikipédia) ; des murs en terre non stabilisée sous climat continental humide ont une durée de vie extrapolée de plus de 60 ans (Bui et al. 2009), à condition d’entretenir l’enduit de la coque.
fr.site_prerequisites: Une terre adaptée sur place, et un moyen de garder la coque au sec : sous climat humide, son enduit protecteur doit être renouvelé régulièrement, ou un toit construit par-dessus.
fr.build_note: une coque de terre autoportante, montée sans coffrage
fr.regulation_fr: Élément de structure ou d’emprise au sol : soumis au permis de construire pour un logement neuf. Les terrains ruraux sont en outre contraints par le zonage PLU de la commune, hors zone constructible, un logement neuf est généralement refusé.
fr.choose_if: vous voulez un bâtiment entièrement en terre, sans bois ni métal pour la toiture.

solutions.name: Kerterre (small hand-sculpted hemp-lime building)
solutions.summary: A small round building sculpted by hand from hemp soaked in lime, with no frame and no moulds; the wall closes over into the roof. It can be a garden shed or one of several small buildings that make up a home. A basic one is about 3 m across and costs about €500 in materials. The walls take a year or two to dry.

ratings.build_note: hemp soaked in lime, sculpted by hand, no frame

solutions.choose_if: you want to build small rooms or a shed by hand, cheaply, with no frame and no moulds.
solutions.lifespan: The oldest kerterre, in Brittany, is over 20 years old and is reported free of leaks and cracks although it is neither lived in nor maintained (kerterre.org FAQ; 18h39, 2020).
solutions.site_prerequisites: The lime, hemp and sand are brought in, so little depends on the site's own soil; what matters is a build season that ends at least two months before the first frost, and heating and ventilation through the first one to two years while the walls dry.
solutions.regulation_fr: Size decides the formality. A construction of 5 m² or less of footprint and floor area needs none (Code de l'urbanisme, art. R421-2); one over 5 m² and up to 20 m² needs a déclaration préalable (art. R421-9); anything larger needs a permis de construire (art. R*421-1). The commune's PLU zoning still applies: outside a constructible zone, a new dwelling is generally refused.

sources.name: Kerterre (Evelyne Adam), FAQ
Piot, Bejat, Jay, Bessette, Wurtz and Barnes-Davin, "Study of a hempcrete wall exposed to outdoor climate: Effects of the coating", Construction and Building Materials 139, 540-550, 2017

fr.name: Kerterre (petit bâtiment en chanvre et chaux)
fr.description: Un petit bâtiment rond sculpté à la main avec du chanvre trempé dans la chaux, sans ossature ni coffrage ; le mur se referme en toit. Il peut servir d’abri de jardin ou être l’une des petites constructions qui forment un foyer. Une kerterre de base fait environ 3 m de diamètre et coûte environ 500 € de matériaux. Les murs mettent un à deux ans à sécher.
fr.lifespan: La plus ancienne kerterre, en Bretagne, a plus de 20 ans et ne présente ni fuite ni fissure signalée, bien qu’elle ne soit ni habitée ni entretenue (FAQ kerterre.org ; 18h39, 2020).
fr.site_prerequisites: La chaux, le chanvre et le sable sont apportés, le sol du terrain compte donc peu ; ce qui compte, c’est un chantier achevé au moins deux mois avant les premières gelées, puis chauffage et aération pendant les un à deux premières années, le temps que les murs sèchent.
fr.build_note: chanvre trempé dans la chaux, sculpté à la main, sans ossature
fr.regulation_fr: La taille décide de la formalité. Une construction de 5 m² ou moins d’emprise au sol et de surface de plancher n’en demande aucune (Code de l’urbanisme, art. R421-2) ; au-delà de 5 m² et jusqu’à 20 m², une déclaration préalable (art. R421-9) ; au-delà, un permis de construire (art. R*421-1). Le zonage du PLU de la commune s’applique toujours : hors zone constructible, un logement neuf est généralement refusé.
fr.choose_if: vous voulez construire à la main de petites pièces ou un abri, à peu de frais, sans ossature ni moule.

solutions.name: Roundhouse (round timber frame with a reciprocal roof)
solutions.summary: A round building on a ring of timber posts, with walls of straw, cob or logs and a roof where each rafter rests on the next, so no central post is needed. A circle gives the most floor for the least wall, and stands up well to wind. Built from local materials, one Welsh roundhouse cost about £3,000.

ratings.build_note: a ring of posts, a self-supporting roof, any local infill

solutions.choose_if: you want a round home from local timber, straw or cob, with a roof that needs no central post.
solutions.lifespan: Twenty years and more for Tony Wrench's roundhouse, with buried post ends replaced by stone along the way (Lowimpact.org interview, 2016); posts on stone pads rather than in the ground last longer.
solutions.site_prerequisites: Timber and a wall material available locally, and a build that keeps the posts out of wet ground.
solutions.regulation_fr: Size decides the formality. A construction of 5 m² or less of footprint and floor area needs none (Code de l'urbanisme, art. R421-2); one over 5 m² and up to 20 m² needs a déclaration préalable (art. R421-9); anything larger needs a permis de construire (art. R*421-1). The commune's PLU zoning still applies: outside a constructible zone, a new dwelling is generally refused.

sources.name: Lowimpact.org, "Roundhouses" (category introduction)
Lowimpact.org, "An interview with Tony Wrench: builder of a £3,000 super-eco roundhouse" (2016)

fr.name: Maison ronde (ossature bois et toit réciproque)
fr.description: Un bâtiment rond sur un cercle de poteaux en bois, avec des murs en paille, en bauge ou en rondins, et un toit où chaque chevron repose sur le suivant, sans poteau central. Le cercle donne le plus de surface pour le moins de mur, et résiste bien au vent. Construite en matériaux locaux, une maison ronde galloise a coûté environ 3 000 £.
fr.lifespan: Vingt ans et plus pour la maison ronde de Tony Wrench, dont des pieds de poteaux enterrés ont été remplacés par de la pierre (entretien Lowimpact.org, 2016) ; des poteaux posés sur des plots de pierre plutôt qu’enterrés durent plus longtemps.
fr.site_prerequisites: Du bois et un matériau de mur disponibles sur place, et une construction qui garde les poteaux hors de la terre humide.
fr.build_note: un cercle de poteaux, un toit autoportant, un remplissage local
fr.regulation_fr: La taille décide de la formalité. Une construction de 5 m² ou moins d’emprise au sol et de surface de plancher n’en demande aucune (Code de l’urbanisme, art. R421-2) ; au-delà de 5 m² et jusqu’à 20 m², une déclaration préalable (art. R421-9) ; au-delà, un permis de construire (art. R*421-1). Le zonage du PLU de la commune s’applique toujours : hors zone constructible, un logement neuf est généralement refusé.
fr.choose_if: vous voulez une maison ronde en bois local, paille ou bauge, avec un toit sans poteau central.

solutions.name: A-frame house
solutions.summary: A house whose steep roof comes down to the ground on both sides, so roof and walls form one triangle. The triangle is strong and sheds snow, and it is simple enough to build from a kit. The sloping walls leave corners too low to use, and warm air gathers at the top.

ratings.build_note: one triangle for roof and walls, simple framing

solutions.choose_if: you want a simple form you can build from a kit, that sheds snow easily.
solutions.lifespan: Matches the structure's lifespan; the roof covering, which is also the wall, is the part that wears.
solutions.site_prerequisites: None specific; the form suits snowy sites, where shedding snow is the point.
solutions.regulation_fr: Size decides the formality. A construction of 5 m² or less of footprint and floor area needs none (Code de l'urbanisme, art. R421-2); one over 5 m² and up to 20 m² needs a déclaration préalable (art. R421-9); anything larger needs a permis de construire (art. R*421-1). The commune's PLU zoning still applies: outside a constructible zone, a new dwelling is generally refused.

sources.name: Washington State Department of Archaeology & Historic Preservation, architectural style guide, "A-Frame"
Wikipedia, "A-frame house"

fr.name: Maison en A
fr.description: Une maison dont le toit très pentu descend jusqu’au sol des deux côtés : toit et murs forment un seul triangle. Le triangle est solide et évacue la neige, et la maison est assez simple pour se construire en kit. Les murs en pente laissent des coins trop bas pour servir, et l’air chaud s’accumule en haut.
fr.lifespan: Celle de la structure ; la couverture, qui fait aussi office de mur, est la partie qui s’use.
fr.site_prerequisites: Aucune en particulier ; la forme convient aux sites enneigés, où évacuer la neige est justement l’intérêt.
fr.build_note: un seul triangle pour le toit et les murs, une charpente simple
fr.regulation_fr: La taille décide de la formalité. Une construction de 5 m² ou moins d’emprise au sol et de surface de plancher n’en demande aucune (Code de l’urbanisme, art. R421-2) ; au-delà de 5 m² et jusqu’à 20 m², une déclaration préalable (art. R421-9) ; au-delà, un permis de construire (art. R*421-1). Le zonage du PLU de la commune s’applique toujours : hors zone constructible, un logement neuf est généralement refusé.
fr.choose_if: vous voulez une forme simple, montable en kit, qui évacue facilement la neige.

solutions.name: Geodesic dome
solutions.summary: A dome made of a lattice of short timber triangles, light but strong because the load spreads over the whole shell. It encloses the most space for the least surface, which saves material and heat. As a home it is hard to keep watertight at its many joints, and furniture fits badly against curved walls.

ratings.build_note: a lattice of triangles, many seams to seal

solutions.choose_if: you want a light, strong shell built from short timbers that are easy to handle.
solutions.lifespan: Limited by the seams rather than the frame: water getting through the joints is what degrades wooden domes.
solutions.site_prerequisites: None specific.
solutions.regulation_fr: Size decides the formality. A construction of 5 m² or less of footprint and floor area needs none (Code de l'urbanisme, art. R421-2); one over 5 m² and up to 20 m² needs a déclaration préalable (art. R421-9); anything larger needs a permis de construire (art. R*421-1). The commune's PLU zoning still applies: outside a constructible zone, a new dwelling is generally refused.

sources.name: González-Avilés, Pérez-Carramiñana, Galiano-Garrigós and Pérez-Millán, "Energy Benefits of Tourist Accommodation Using Geodesic Domes", Buildings 14(2), 505, 2024 (simulation, cold semi-arid climate)
Wikipedia, "Geodesic dome" (residential use, citing Lloyd Kahn)

fr.name: Dôme géodésique
fr.description: Un dôme fait d’un treillis de courts triangles en bois, léger mais solide parce que la charge se répartit sur toute la coque. Il enferme le plus d’espace pour le moins de surface, ce qui économise matériaux et chaleur. Comme habitation, il est difficile à garder étanche à ses nombreuses jonctions, et les meubles s’adaptent mal aux murs courbes.
fr.lifespan: Limitée par les jonctions plus que par l’ossature : c’est l’eau qui passe par les joints qui dégrade les dômes en bois.
fr.site_prerequisites: Aucune en particulier.
fr.build_note: un treillis de triangles, beaucoup de joints à rendre étanches
fr.regulation_fr: La taille décide de la formalité. Une construction de 5 m² ou moins d’emprise au sol et de surface de plancher n’en demande aucune (Code de l’urbanisme, art. R421-2) ; au-delà de 5 m² et jusqu’à 20 m², une déclaration préalable (art. R421-9) ; au-delà, un permis de construire (art. R*421-1). Le zonage du PLU de la commune s’applique toujours : hors zone constructible, un logement neuf est généralement refusé.
fr.choose_if: vous voulez une coque légère et solide, faite de bois courts faciles à manipuler.

solutions.name: Earth-bermed house (earth banked against the walls)
solutions.summary: A house built at ground level with earth banked against three of its walls, the roof and the south side left clear. The earth keeps the covered walls at a steady temperature and out of the wind. Such houses can need far less heating, but the walls must be waterproofed and drained.

ratings.build_note: earth banked against the walls, roof left clear

solutions.choose_if: you want far less heating without digging the house into the ground.
solutions.lifespan: Matches the structure; the waterproofing membrane is the wearing part, typically renewed every 20-30 years.
solutions.site_prerequisites: Free-draining soil (sand, gravel) is easiest; clay needs drainage designed in. No slope needed.
solutions.regulation_fr: Part of the structure or footprint: covered by the building permit (permis de construire) for a new dwelling. Rural sites are additionally constrained by the commune's PLU zoning, outside a constructible zone, a new dwelling is generally refused.

sources.name: Akubue, J.A., "Earth Shelters; A Review of Energy Conservation Properties in Earth Sheltered Housing", in Energy Conservation, ed. A.Z. Ahmed, InTech, 2012
Washington State Department of Archaeology & Historic Preservation, architectural style guide, "Earth Shelter"

fr.name: Maison en butte de terre (murs remblayés)
fr.description: Une maison construite au niveau du sol, avec de la terre remblayée contre trois de ses murs, le toit et la façade sud restant dégagés. La terre garde les murs couverts à une température stable et à l’abri du vent. Ces maisons peuvent demander bien moins de chauffage, mais les murs doivent être étanchés et drainés.
fr.lifespan: Celle de la structure ; la membrane d’étanchéité est la partie qui s’use, en général à renouveler tous les 20 à 30 ans.
fr.site_prerequisites: Un sol drainant (sable, gravier) est le plus simple ; l’argile demande un drainage prévu dès la conception. Pas besoin de pente.
fr.build_note: de la terre remblayée contre les murs, le toit dégagé
fr.regulation_fr: Élément de structure ou d’emprise au sol : soumis au permis de construire pour un logement neuf. Les terrains ruraux sont en outre contraints par le zonage PLU de la commune, hors zone constructible, un logement neuf est généralement refusé.
fr.choose_if: vous voulez beaucoup moins de chauffage sans enterrer la maison.

solutions.name: Insulating furniture (hooded chair, folding screen)
solutions.summary: Furniture that shelters the person rather than the room: a high-backed chair with a hood, a folding screen behind the seat. It blocks draughts and shields you from cold walls and windows. With a small heater nearby, it keeps the warmth around you, so the room itself can stay cooler.

ratings.build_note: bought or joinery, no heat source of its own

solutions.choose_if: you want to stay warm where you sit, sheltered from cold walls and draughts.
solutions.lifespan: Furniture, so as long as the joinery and upholstery.
solutions.site_prerequisites: None; nothing is fixed to the building, so a tenant can use it.

sources.name: Low-tech Magazine (Kris De Decker), "How to Keep Warm in a Cool House", 2015

fr.name: Mobilier isolant (fauteuil à capuchon, paravent)
fr.description: Du mobilier qui abrite la personne plutôt que la pièce : un fauteuil à haut dossier avec un capuchon, un paravent derrière le siège. Il coupe les courants d’air et protège des murs et des fenêtres froids. Avec un petit chauffage à côté, il garde la chaleur autour de soi, et la pièce peut rester plus fraîche.
fr.lifespan: Du mobilier : aussi longtemps que la menuiserie et la garniture.
fr.site_prerequisites: Aucune ; rien n’est fixé au bâtiment, un locataire peut donc l’utiliser.
fr.build_note: acheté ou fait en menuiserie, sans source de chaleur propre
fr.choose_if: vous voulez rester au chaud là où vous êtes assis, à l’abri des murs froids et des courants d’air.

solutions.name: Yurt (round lattice-frame dwelling)
solutions.summary: A round home of a folding wooden lattice wall and roof poles meeting at a central ring, covered in felt or canvas. It needs no foundation and can be put up in a couple of hours. Lived in all year, it needs a stove, insulation and good airing, and the cover wears out after 8 to 15 years.

ratings.build_note: a folding lattice, poles and a crown, under a cover

solutions.choose_if: you want a home you can put up in hours, move, and live in without a foundation.
solutions.lifespan: Cover 8-15 years depending on exposure; a cared-for wooden frame lasts decades (a manufacturer's figures).
solutions.site_prerequisites: A level, drained platform; a stove and ventilation if it is lived in through a wet winter.
solutions.regulation_fr: A yurt lived in as a main home at least eight months a year, with no foundation and easily dismantled at any time, is a "résidence démontable constituant l'habitat permanent" (Code de l'urbanisme, art. R111-51), which the commune's PLU has to allow. Its footprint then sets the formality as for any small building: none up to 5 m², a déclaration préalable up to 20 m², a permis de construire above.

tutorials.title: Déplacer une Yourt
tutorials.line: How-to: moving a yurt

sources.name: Wikipedia, "Yurt"
The Out Factory (yurt manufacturer), "Yurt Lifespan: Durability and Year-Round Use"

fr.name: Yourte (habitat rond à treillis démontable)
fr.description: Un habitat rond fait d’un mur en treillis de bois pliant et de perches de toit qui se rejoignent sur un anneau central, couvert de feutre ou de toile. Il ne demande aucune fondation et se monte en quelques heures. Habité toute l’année, il lui faut un poêle, une isolation et une bonne aération, et la couverture s’use en 8 à 15 ans.
fr.lifespan: Couverture 8 à 15 ans selon l’exposition ; une ossature en bois entretenue dure des décennies (chiffres d’un fabricant).
fr.site_prerequisites: Une plateforme plane et drainée ; un poêle et une aération si elle est habitée pendant un hiver humide.
fr.build_note: un treillis pliant, des perches et une couronne, sous une couverture
fr.regulation_fr: Une yourte habitée à titre de résidence principale au moins huit mois par an, sans fondation et démontable à tout moment, est une « résidence démontable constituant l’habitat permanent » (Code de l’urbanisme, art. R111-51), que le PLU de la commune doit permettre. Son emprise fixe ensuite la formalité comme pour tout petit bâtiment : aucune jusqu’à 5 m², une déclaration préalable jusqu’à 20 m², un permis de construire au-delà.
fr.choose_if: vous voulez un habitat qui se monte en quelques heures, se déplace, et se passe de fondation.

solutions.name: Underground courtyard house (sunken pit dwelling)
solutions.summary: A house dug below ground around an open courtyard, its rooms opening off the courtyard walls for light and air. The surrounding earth keeps the rooms at a steady temperature. It suits flat, warm, dry ground with firm soil, and is hard to keep dry and bright.

ratings.build_note: a dug courtyard, rooms opening off its walls

solutions.choose_if: you have flat, firm, dry ground in a warm climate and want a private home around its own courtyard.
solutions.lifespan: Matches the structure where the soil stands and the waterproofing is kept up; the membrane and the courtyard drainage are the wearing parts.
solutions.site_prerequisites: Flat ground, soil that stands when cut or an engineered retaining structure, a way to drain the courtyard, and a warm, dry climate is easiest.
solutions.regulation_fr: Part of the structure or footprint: covered by the building permit (permis de construire) for a new dwelling. Rural sites are additionally constrained by the commune's PLU zoning, outside a constructible zone, a new dwelling is generally refused.

sources.name: Akubue, J.A., "Earth Shelters; A Review of Energy Conservation Properties in Earth Sheltered Housing", in Energy Conservation, ed. A.Z. Ahmed, InTech, 2012 (the envelope or atrium type)
Wikipedia, "Yaodong" (sunken courtyard yaodong)

fr.name: Maison enterrée autour d’un patio
fr.description: Une maison creusée sous le sol autour d’une cour à ciel ouvert, dont les pièces s’ouvrent sur les parois de la cour pour la lumière et l’air. La terre autour garde les pièces à une température stable. Elle convient aux terrains plats, chauds et secs, au sol ferme, et reste difficile à garder sèche et lumineuse.
fr.lifespan: Celle de la structure si le sol tient et que l’étanchéité est entretenue ; la membrane et le drainage de la cour sont les parties qui s’usent.
fr.site_prerequisites: Un terrain plat, un sol qui tient une fois taillé ou un soutènement conçu pour, un moyen de drainer la cour ; un climat chaud et sec est le plus simple.
fr.build_note: une cour creusée, des pièces ouvertes sur ses parois
fr.regulation_fr: Élément de structure ou d’emprise au sol : soumis au permis de construire pour un logement neuf. Les terrains ruraux sont en outre contraints par le zonage PLU de la commune, hors zone constructible, un logement neuf est généralement refusé.
fr.choose_if: vous avez un terrain plat, ferme et sec sous un climat chaud, et voulez une maison intime autour de sa propre cour.

solutions.name: Insulating pot skirt
solutions.summary: A sleeve around a pot while it is on the heat, leaving a narrow gap so the heat stays against the pot’s sides instead of escaping around it. Over a wood or gas flame it is a metal sleeve; for a hob, a sewn cosy of wool or felt. It cuts the fuel needed to boil and to keep a boil going. Unlike the haybox, it works during cooking, not after.

ratings.build_note: a sleeve round the pot, cut or sewn

solutions.choose_if: you want the flame’s heat to stay on the pot while it cooks, for a few euros.
solutions.lifespan: As long as the metal or fabric; a fabric cosy wears where it meets the heat.
solutions.site_prerequisites: None. A fabric cosy must be kept clear of an open flame.

tutorials.line: Full build: an insulating skirt for a pot

tutorials.title: Jupe isolante de casserole ou bouilloire
tutorials.line: Full build: an insulating skirt for a pot

tutorials.title: Jupe isolante

fr.name: Jupe isolante (casserole ou brûleur)
fr.description: Un manchon autour d’une casserole pendant qu’elle chauffe, avec un espace étroit qui garde la chaleur contre ses flancs au lieu de la laisser s’échapper autour. Sur une flamme de bois ou de gaz, c’est un manchon de métal ; sur une plaque, une housse cousue en laine ou en feutre. Il réduit l’énergie nécessaire pour porter à ébullition et la maintenir. Contrairement à la marmite norvégienne, il agit pendant la cuisson, pas après.
fr.lifespan: Aussi longtemps que le métal ou le tissu ; une housse s’use là où elle touche la chaleur.
fr.site_prerequisites: Aucune. Une housse en tissu doit rester à l’écart d’une flamme nue.
fr.build_note: un manchon autour de la casserole, découpé ou cousu
fr.choose_if: vous voulez que la chaleur de la flamme reste sur la casserole pendant la cuisson, pour quelques euros.

solutions.name: Black soldier fly larvae composter
solutions.summary: A warm, covered bin where larvae of the black soldier fly eat kitchen scraps, cooked food included, in days rather than months. They cut the waste by 60 to 85% of its dry weight, leave a residue for the compost, and grow into a protein-rich feed for hens or fish. The flies need 25 to 32 °C to breed, so in a cool climate the bin lives indoors.

ratings.build_note: a covered bin, a colony to start

solutions.choose_if: you want kitchen scraps, cooked food included, gone in days and turned into feed for hens or fish.
solutions.lifespan: The bin lasts years; the colony has to be kept going through the winter, or restarted.
solutions.site_prerequisites: A warm, sheltered corner (25 to 32 °C for the adult flies); indoors in winter.

tutorials.title: Elevage de Mouches Soldats Noires
tutorials.line: How-to: raising black soldier flies

fr.name: Bac à larves de mouches soldats noires
fr.description: Un bac chaud et couvert où les larves de la mouche soldat noire mangent les restes de cuisine, plats cuisinés compris, en quelques jours plutôt qu’en quelques mois. Elles réduisent les déchets de 60 à 85 % de leur poids sec, laissent un résidu pour le compost et deviennent un aliment riche en protéines pour les poules ou les poissons. Les mouches ont besoin de 25 à 32 °C pour se reproduire : sous un climat frais, le bac vit à l’intérieur.
fr.lifespan: Le bac dure des années ; la colonie doit passer l’hiver, ou être relancée.
fr.site_prerequisites: Un coin chaud et abrité (25 à 32 °C pour les mouches adultes) ; à l’intérieur en hiver.
fr.build_note: un bac couvert, une colonie à lancer
fr.choose_if: vous voulez que les restes de cuisine, plats cuisinés compris, disparaissent en quelques jours et nourrissent poules ou poissons.

solutions.name: Earth wood-fired bread oven
solutions.summary: A domed oven of clay, sand and straw, built outdoors on a raised base. A fire burns inside until the thick earth walls are hot, the embers are raked out, and bread, pizza or slow dishes bake in the stored heat with the door shut. A smaller oven heats faster on less wood. It bakes outside, so the house does not overheat in summer.

ratings.build_note: earth layers shaped by hand over a sand form

solutions.choose_if: you want to bake bread and pizza outdoors on wood, without heating the house.
solutions.lifespan: Years under a roof; unprotected earth washes away in the rain.
solutions.site_prerequisites: Outdoor space, a roof or shelter over the oven, and clay soil or bought clay.

tutorials.title: Four à bois en terre crue

fr.name: Four à bois en terre crue
fr.description: Un four en dôme d’argile, de sable et de paille, construit dehors sur un socle surélevé. On y fait un feu jusqu’à ce que les murs épais en terre soient chauds, on retire les braises, puis pain, pizzas ou plats mijotés cuisent dans la chaleur accumulée, porte fermée. Plus le four est petit, plus il chauffe vite et avec peu de bois. Il cuit dehors : la maison ne surchauffe pas l’été.
fr.lifespan: Des années sous un toit ; la terre non protégée se délave sous la pluie.
fr.site_prerequisites: De la place dehors, un toit ou un abri au-dessus du four, et une terre argileuse ou de l’argile achetée.
fr.build_note: des couches de terre façonnées à la main sur un moule de sable
fr.choose_if: vous voulez cuire pain et pizzas dehors au bois, sans chauffer la maison.

solutions.name: Insulated cool box
solutions.summary: A well-insulated box that keeps already-cold food cold with ice or frozen packs. It makes no cold of its own: it carries it, from a freezer, a winter night or a shop. Its place in a low-tech home is the power cut: a fridge keeps food safe for about four hours without power, and a cool box with enough ice keeps it at 4 °C or below well beyond.

ratings.build_note: an insulated box, bought or built

solutions.choose_if: you want food kept cold through a power cut, or away from the kitchen, with no power at all.
solutions.lifespan: Decades if the lid seal is kept.
solutions.site_prerequisites: A source of ice or frozen packs.

tutorials.title: Néo-Glaciaire - La Glacière low-tech
tutorials.line: Full build: a low-tech icebox

fr.name: Glacière isolée
fr.description: Une boîte bien isolée qui garde au froid des aliments déjà froids, avec de la glace ou des pains de glace. Elle ne produit pas de froid : elle le transporte, depuis un congélateur, une nuit d’hiver ou un magasin. Sa place dans une maison low-tech, c’est la coupure de courant : un réfrigérateur garde les aliments sûrs environ quatre heures sans électricité, une glacière assez chargée en glace les garde à 4 °C ou moins bien au-delà.
fr.lifespan: Des décennies si le joint du couvercle est entretenu.
fr.site_prerequisites: Une source de glace ou de pains de glace.
fr.build_note: une boîte isolée, achetée ou construite
fr.choose_if: vous voulez garder des aliments au froid pendant une coupure de courant, ou loin de la cuisine, sans aucune électricité.

solutions.name: Boiling-water bath preserving (pasteurisation)
solutions.summary: Jars of fruit, jam, pickles, juice or acidified tomatoes heated in boiling water for a tested time, then sealed as they cool. It keeps acid foods for months at room temperature with nothing but a large pot. It is safe for acid foods only: vegetables, meat and other low-acid foods need a pressure canner, because boiling does not destroy botulism spores.
solutions.choose_if: you want fruit, jams and pickles to keep for months with just a large pot.
solutions.lifespan: The pot and jars for decades; the lids or seals are replaced.
solutions.site_prerequisites: None.

tutorials.title: Pasteurisateur au feu de bois
tutorials.line: Full build: a wood-fired pasteuriser

tutorial_lines_fr.https://wiki.lowtechlab.org/wiki/Pasteur: Fabrication complète : un pasteurisateur au feu de bois

sources.name: National Center for Home Food Preservation (University of Georgia), "Ensuring Safe Canned Foods"

fr.name: Conserves au bain-marie (pasteurisation)
fr.description: Des bocaux de fruits, de confitures, de conserves au vinaigre, de jus ou de tomates acidifiées chauffés dans l’eau bouillante pendant un temps éprouvé, puis fermés en refroidissant. Cela garde les aliments acides des mois à température ambiante, avec une simple grande marmite. C’est sûr pour les aliments acides seulement : légumes, viandes et autres aliments peu acides demandent un autoclave, car l’ébullition ne détruit pas les spores du botulisme.
fr.lifespan: La marmite et les bocaux pendant des décennies ; les couvercles ou joints se remplacent.
fr.site_prerequisites: Aucune.
fr.build_note: une grande marmite et des bocaux
fr.choose_if: vous voulez garder fruits, confitures et conserves au vinaigre des mois avec une simple grande marmite.

solutions.name: Gravity-fed pellet stove (no electricity)
solutions.summary: A pellet stove with no motor and no fan: pellets fall from a hopper into the fire by their own weight, and the fire draws its own air. It gives the steady heat of a pellet stove without electricity, so it keeps working in a power cut. A commercial one runs up to about a day on a full hopper; a home-built one from an oil drum runs about six hours.

ratings.build_note: an oil drum, a pellet reservoir, a flue pipe

solutions.choose_if: you want steady pellet heat that keeps going in a power cut.
solutions.lifespan: As a wood stove: decades for the steel body, with gaskets and baffles replaced.
solutions.site_prerequisites: A flue, and dry storage for bagged pellets.

tutorials.title: Poêle à pellets
tutorials.line: Full build: a pellet stove

tutorial_lines_fr.https://wiki.lowtechlab.org/wiki/Po%C3%A: Fabrication complète : un poêle à pellets

fr.name: Poêle à granulés sans électricité (alimentation par gravité)
fr.description: Un poêle à granulés sans moteur ni ventilateur : les granulés tombent d’une trémie dans le feu par leur propre poids, et le feu aspire lui-même son air. Il donne la chaleur régulière d’un poêle à granulés sans électricité, et continue donc de chauffer pendant une coupure. Un modèle du commerce tient jusqu’à une journée sur une trémie pleine ; un modèle fait maison dans un fût tient environ six heures.
fr.lifespan: Comme un poêle à bois : des décennies pour le corps en acier, joints et déflecteurs remplacés.
fr.site_prerequisites: Un conduit de fumée, et un stockage au sec pour les granulés en sacs.
fr.build_note: un fût, un réservoir à granulés, un tuyau de fumée
fr.choose_if: vous voulez une chaleur régulière aux granulés qui continue pendant une coupure de courant.

solutions.name: Desiccant moisture absorber
solutions.summary: A container of salt crystals that draw water vapour out of the air in a small damp space, a cupboard or a wardrobe, and drip it into a tray below. It treats a pocket of damp; it does not dry a house. Ventilation, airing and drying laundry outdoors come first.

ratings.build_note: a bottle, a mesh and salt

solutions.choose_if: a cupboard or a small room stays damp and you want to draw the moisture out with no power.
solutions.lifespan: The container for years; the salt is replaced as it dissolves.
solutions.site_prerequisites: None.

tutorials.line: Full build: an air dehumidifier

fr.name: Absorbeur d’humidité au sel
fr.description: Un récipient de cristaux de sel qui captent la vapeur d’eau de l’air dans un petit espace humide, un placard ou une armoire, et la font goutter dans un bac en dessous. Il traite une poche d’humidité ; il n’assèche pas une maison. La ventilation, l’aération et le séchage du linge dehors passent avant.
fr.lifespan: Le récipient pendant des années ; le sel se remplace à mesure qu’il se dissout.
fr.site_prerequisites: Aucune.
fr.build_note: une bouteille, une grille et du sel
fr.choose_if: un placard ou une petite pièce reste humide et vous voulez en retirer l’humidité sans électricité.

bases.basis: per m2 of catchment per mm of rain
bases.description: Harvested volume per unit of roof area per unit of rainfall. In metric 1 mm on 1 m2 IS 1 litre by geometry, so the coefficient is purely the collection-efficiency term.
Electrical yield per unit of installed peak power, at a stated location, tilt and system loss.

bases.basis: per m2 of collector per year
bases.description: Thermal yield per unit of collector area per year, per climate zone.
Instantaneous or period-average output per unit of collector area.
A demand-side draw already integrated over frequency and duration. PREFER THIS over a computed flow x duration x frequency: every multiplication multiplies uncertainty.
Treatment area required per person-equivalent. EH is defined in France as 60 g/day BOD5.
Capacity rating expressed in person-equivalents, as used by the French ANC agrements.
Annual accumulation per person, e.g. composting-toilet chamber volume.

bases.basis: per m3/s per metre of head
bases.description: Hydraulic power coefficient. Both Q and H are measurable by the reader with a bucket and a tape, which is why this qualifies where wind does not.
Device throughput per hour, at a stated operating condition.
Device throughput per day, at a stated operating condition.
Device operating rate per minute, at a stated condition. The minutes are the DEVICE's running time, not a person's use, so nothing behavioural attaches here.
Volume per use. Uses per day is BEHAVIOURAL and is never asked; the spread widens the band instead.

usage.source: Measured flush COUNTS, independent of any flush volume. The 2016 Residential End Uses of Water Study puts it at 5 per person per day; Flume's 2021 analysis of 5.9 million flushes puts it at 5.5. Widened to 4-7 for household variation. REPLACED A CIRCULAR DERIVATION on 2026-09-04, the same defect found in the shower basis the same day: the previous 3-6 was back-calculated by taking Cieau's 20 pc of 148 L (about 30 L per person per day) and dividing by the 6-12 L per flush this basis then multiplies back in. THE TWO DATASETS AGREE ONCE THE CIRCULARITY IS REMOVED, which is the reassuring part: 30 L per person per day over 5.5 flushes implies about 5.5 L a flush, which is exactly a modern dual-flush average. The old derivation came out low only because it divided by the 6-12 L of OLDER stock.

bases.description: Consumption per LAUNDRY cycle. The name carries the appliance class on purpose: the usage range below is the EU washing-machine reference of 220 cycles a year, and a dishwasher or an electric composter running on a different rhythm would have inherited it silently while the basis was called simply 'per cycle'.

usage.source: EU regulatory reference is 220 standard washing cycles per year = 0.60 per day per household. Range widened either side to cover household size.

bases.description: Biogas yield per kg VS. NOT per kg of wet feedstock: that is a 4-6x difference and is the single easiest denominator in the catalogue to get wrong.
Annual consumption or output, as published on a regulatory label.
A conversion along a chain: efficiency, COP, recovery rate, round-trip. Multiplies, never seeds.

Consumption per minute of SHOWERING. Named for the behaviour rather than the unit: a kitchen tap is also used by the minute and is not used for the same number of them, and while this was called 'per minute of use' nothing stopped one adopting the other's duration.

usage.source: Shower-duration surveys, INDEPENDENT of the litres-per-day figure this basis is unioned with. Europeans commonly 5-7 minutes and adults generally 7-9; the GROHE and Mira showering surveys put Britain at 9.6 minutes and Germany at 9.1; a University of Granada study measured 8.8 in summer and 11.6 in winter. REPLACED A CIRCULAR DERIVATION on 2026-09-04: the previous range, 5-13 minutes, was back-calculated by dividing the Agences de l'Eau 60-80 L per person per day by this same 6-12 L/min rate, and the engine then multiplied the rate back in. Unioning a figure with a figure derived FROM it is not two independent readings of one quantity, which is what the union rule assumes. The numbers barely moved; the reasoning is no longer circular.

bases.description: Luminous efficacy: light delivered per watt drawn. A conversion, but into daylight, which no other figure is measured in, so it can never join a total.

The EU hob metric: watt-hours to heat one kilogram of water under a standardised test. Turning it into an efficiency needs the test's temperature rise and cookware, so it is recorded as published rather than converted.

Biogas produced per kilogram of WET kitchen waste as it is actually thrown away. The primary literature is stated per kg of VOLATILE SOLIDS, which is a 4-6x different denominator and not a quantity anyone can weigh; this basis folds the wet-to-VS conversion in so the reader supplies what they know.

The share of the water driving a device that it actually delivers. A ram pump is the case: it takes a stream and lifts a small fraction of it, letting the rest run on. The reader supplies the stream flow, which is measurable with a bucket and a stopwatch.

Consumption per DISHWASHING cycle, one full machine load or the hand-washed equivalent. Named for its appliance class, like the laundry basis, because a usage range is one rhythm and washing up is not on the same one as laundry.

usage.source: Observed dishwasher use across six European countries averages 5.0 cycles a week per household, with country means from 3.9 to 5.4, which is 0.56-0.77 a day. INDEPENDENT of the per-cycle volumes it multiplies: it comes from a usage-behaviour survey, not from dividing a daily total by a cycle size.

bases.basis: per m2 of fog net per foggy day
bases.description: Water caught per square metre of net, on a day when fog actually passes through. The denominator is a FOGGY day and not a calendar day on purpose: a fog net produces nothing on a clear one, so turning this into an annual figure needs a count of fog days at the site, which this catalogue does not hold for anywhere in France.

coefficients.basis: per m2 of catchment per mm of rain
coefficients.condition: What reaches the tank, after the first flush is diverted and the gutters have lost their share.
coefficients.condition_fr: Ce qui arrive dans la cuve, une fois les premières eaux écartées et les pertes des gouttières déduites.
coefficients.source: Texas Water Development Board, The Texas Manual on Rainwater Harvesting, 3rd ed., pp. 35 and 43
coefficients.notes: Manual states 75-90 pc and uses 85 pc in its worked example. 1 mm on 1 m2 is 1 L by geometry, so this coefficient IS the efficiency term. Stated on the OUTPUT: a SOURCE figure describes output produced per unit of the input resource, and the basis already names rain as the denominator. Booking it on the input made the engine read it as demand. | Condition as first written: after first-flush and collection losses

coefficients.basis: per m2 of catchment per mm of rain
coefficients.condition: What reaches the tank, after the first flush is diverted and the gutters have lost their share.
coefficients.condition_fr: Ce qui arrive dans la cuve, une fois les premières eaux écartées et les pertes des gouttières déduites.
coefficients.source: Texas Water Development Board, The Texas Manual on Rainwater Harvesting, 3rd ed., pp. 35 and 43
coefficients.notes: Same coefficient as the roof case, on a smaller catchment. Stated on the OUTPUT: a SOURCE figure describes output produced per unit of the input resource, and the basis already names rain as the denominator. Booking it on the input made the engine read it as demand. | Condition as first written: after first-flush and collection losses

coefficients.condition: Facing south at the best tilt, after 14% system losses, for your département. The range is how much a good year differs from a poor one.
coefficients.condition_fr: Plein sud à la meilleure inclinaison, après 14 % de pertes du système, pour votre département. La fourchette est l’écart entre une bonne et une mauvaise année.
coefficients.source: JRC PVGIS v5.2 PVcalc (European Commission), live API
coefficients.notes: Central value 1136.7, SD 44.5 (3.9 pc). Monthly Jan 48.0 to Jul 130.6, a 2.72x seasonal ratio: the worst-month check is not optional for this row. SCALES WITH THE READER'S CLIMATE 2026-09-05. This figure is an absolute yield measured at Caen, so before this every reader in France was shown a Caen array's output -- about 38 pc low for the Mediterranean, where the same panel returns 1575 kWh/kWp against Caen's 1137. The engine now scales the band by the reader's zone against this reference zone, keeping the band's relative width, which is year-to-year variation and does not shrink because you moved south. | Condition as first written: Caen 49.18/-0.37, optimal 39 deg south, 14 pc system loss; range is +/-2 SD of year-to-year variation

coefficients.condition: The exchanger's rated efficiency. Over a whole season the system does a little less, once the fans' power and the ducts' losses are counted.
coefficients.condition_fr: Le rendement nominal de l’échangeur. Sur une saison, le système fait un peu moins, une fois comptés les ventilateurs et les pertes des gaines.
coefficients.source: ADEME and Effinergie
coefficients.notes: Closes the standing one-unsourced-performance-claim item. The nominal-vs-seasonal distinction is the condition and must not be dropped. | Condition as first written: NOMINAL exchanger efficiency, not seasonal system efficiency, which is lower once fan power and duct losses count

coefficients.condition: On the eco 40–60 programme, the cycle every machine is tested on.
coefficients.condition_fr: Sur le programme éco 40-60, le cycle sur lequel toute machine est testée.
coefficients.source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/2014, figures as published per model in EPREL
coefficients.notes: EU regulatory reference for frequency is 220 standard cycles per year. Two independent models landed within 12 pc on water. | Condition as first written: eco 40-60 programme, the mandated test cycle

coefficients.condition: On the eco 40–60 programme, the cycle every machine is tested on.
coefficients.condition_fr: Sur le programme éco 40-60, le cycle sur lequel toute machine est testée.
coefficients.source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/2014, figures as published per model in EPREL
coefficients.notes: Two independent models landed within 3 pc on energy. | Condition as first written: eco 40-60 programme, the mandated test cycle

coefficients.condition: The average fridge in use in Europe: 181 kWh a year in 2020. An old fridge can use more than twice that.
coefficients.condition_fr: Le réfrigérateur moyen en service en Europe : 181 kWh par an en 2020. Un vieux réfrigérateur peut consommer plus du double.
coefficients.source: European Commission, Ecodesign Impact Accounting
coefficients.notes: A newly purchased unit under the current label sits near the bottom of this range; the range covers what is actually installed. | Condition as first written: EU installed stock; the 2020 average was 181 kWh/yr against a 417 kWh/yr no-measures counterfactual in the same source

coefficients.condition: From a water-saving head (6 to 8 litres a minute) to an ordinary one (up to 12).
coefficients.condition_fr: D’un pommeau économe (6 à 8 litres par minute) à un pommeau ordinaire (jusqu’à 12).
coefficients.source: Commission Decision 2013/250/EU and the JRC Green Public Procurement technical background report
coefficients.notes: CORRECTS an earlier 15-20 L/min figure that no Tier A source supports. That was a 2-3x error on the largest single household water use and was enough to flip a verdict. | Condition as first written: 6 L/min is the EU Ecolabel water-saving default, 8 its maximum, 8-12 the ceilings applied by national schemes

coefficients.condition: Similar to a mains shower, but at its low end: with only little height above the head, less water comes out.
coefficients.condition_fr: Similaire à une douche sur le réseau, mais dans le bas de la fourchette : avec si peu de hauteur au-dessus du pommeau, il en sort forcément moins d’eau.
coefficients.source: Commission Decision 2013/250/EU and the JRC Green Public Procurement technical background report
coefficients.notes: Kept at the same range rather than narrowed by inference: no source was found for a gravity-specific figure. | Condition as first written: as the pressurised case; a gravity shower runs at the low end because low head limits flow

coefficients.condition: Toilets as they are in most homes today, single and old dual-flush ones.
coefficients.condition_fr: Les toilettes telles qu’elles sont dans la plupart des logements, à simple ou double chasse ancienne génération.
coefficients.source: Agences de l'Eau, Les economies d'eau, via Office International de l'Eau
coefficients.notes: Closes the visible gap found when the engine first ran on the built-in water example: this row carried no figure, so a rainwater graph reported GREEN while never adding up its largest demand. Source sheet published 2012 with an unspecified data date, so it reflects older stock than a new NF unit. | Condition as first written: installed stock, single-flush and older dual units

coefficients.condition: A certified dual-flush toilet, small and full flush together.
coefficients.condition_fr: Des toilettes à double chasse certifiées, petite et grande chasse ensemble.
coefficients.source: Trade press reporting the NF certification rule (3/6 L); corroborated against the Agences de l'Eau 6-12 L range for older stock
coefficients.notes: TIER C AND SHOULD BE UPGRADED. NF EN 997 was not read directly and Legifrance returns 403 to automated fetches. The figure is widely attested and consistent with the installed-stock range, but it has not met the Tier A/B bar. | Condition as first written: NF-certified dual-flush unit, small and full flush

coefficients.condition: 5 m² per main room, and never less than 20 m². French rules count one person per main room.
coefficients.condition_fr: 5 m² par pièce principale, et jamais moins de 20 m². Les règles françaises comptent une personne par pièce principale.
coefficients.source: Arrete du 7 septembre 2009 (prescriptions techniques ANC), France
coefficients.notes: A SIZING figure, not a flow: the Bases sheet marks this basis as not contributing to the arithmetic, so it is shown and never summed into a pool of litres. | Condition as first written: 5 m2 per piece principale with a 20 m2 floor regardless of size; French ANC convention counts one person-equivalent per piece principale, and defines EH as 60 g/day BOD5

coefficients.condition: Size of a vertical-flow reed bed treating all the household’s wastewater: 1.5 to 3 m² for each person, in one bed.
coefficients.condition_fr: Taille d’un filtre planté à écoulement vertical traitant toutes les eaux usées du foyer : 1,5 à 3 m² par personne, en un seul filtre.
coefficients.source: INRAE published work on filtres plantes de roseaux, plus the dimensioning stated in French agrement documentation
coefficients.notes: About 2 m2/EH is the commonly quoted design figure; 1.5-3 is the range across the literature. A SIZING figure, excluded from the flow arithmetic. | Condition as first written: vertical-flow reed bed treating domestic wastewater; EH defined as 60 g/day BOD5

coefficients.condition: Size of a reed bed treating the household’s toilet water: 1.5 to 3 m² for each person, in one bed.
coefficients.condition_fr: Taille d’un filtre planté traitant les eaux des toilettes du foyer : 1,5 à 3 m² par personne, en un seul filtre.
coefficients.source: INRAE published work on filtres plantes de roseaux, plus the dimensioning stated in French agrement documentation
coefficients.notes: Same basis and caveat as the greywater reed bed. A SIZING figure, excluded from the flow arithmetic. | Condition as first written: reed bed treating blackwater; EH defined as 60 g/day BOD5

coefficients.condition: Heat delivered for each unit of electricity, averaged over a heating season in a mid-European climate, not the figure on the label. 2.5 is the legal minimum, 4 a good unit.
coefficients.condition_fr: La chaleur fournie pour chaque unité d’électricité, en moyenne sur une saison de chauffe dans un climat européen moyen, et non le chiffre de l’étiquette. 2,5 est le minimum légal, 4 un bon appareil.
coefficients.source: Commission Regulation (EU) No 813/2013 (ecodesign, space heaters), with SCOP defined by EN 14825
coefficients.notes: The first RATIO the engine can actually exercise on real catalogue data: its input pool is electricity, which solar PV can fill. Seasonal-vs-nameplate is the condition and must not be dropped -- a nameplate COP at 7 degC flatters a real winter. | Condition as first written: SEASONAL coefficient of performance (SCOP) under the EN 14825 average-climate profile, NOT a nameplate COP at one test point. 2.5 is the regulatory floor implied by the 100 pc minimum seasonal space heating efficiency at a conversion coefficient of 2.5; 4.0 corresponds to about 160 pc.

coefficients.condition: At most 0.4 litres a minute, when the basin is full, but it slows as the water level drops.
coefficients.condition_fr: Au mieux 0,4 litre par minute, quand le bassin est plein, mais le débit baisse avec le niveau d’eau.
coefficients.source: CAWST, Biosand Filter Manual (design, construction, installation)
coefficients.notes: A THROUGHPUT LIMIT, not a supply: this filter produces nothing on its own and can only pass on what reaches it. Added specifically to exercise the engine's CAPACITY path, which had never run on real data. | Condition as first written: 0.4 L/min (24 L/h) is the MAXIMUM, reached only with the basin full; the rate falls as the standing water drops, so a batch-averaged rate is lower. Loading rate is capped at 600 L/h per m2 of filter area.

coefficients.condition: One shower a person a day, at 60 to 80 litres each (the French water agencies' figure, from 2012). A water-saving head uses less.
coefficients.condition_fr: Une douche par personne et par jour, à 60 à 80 litres chacune (le chiffre des Agences de l’eau, de 2012). Un pommeau économe en consomme moins.
coefficients.source: Agences de l'Eau, Les economies d'eau, via Office International de l'Eau
coefficients.notes: SECOND BASIS for a quantity that already has one, deliberately. The two constructions of household shower use disagree, and the union rule exists so the reader sees that uncertainty rather than an editorial pick they cannot audit. | Condition as first written: one shower per person per day at the Agences de l'Eau figure of 60-80 L per shower. A PUBLISHED per-person-per-day quantity rather than a product of flow rate x duration x frequency, which is the form that compounds uncertainty. Source sheet published 2012, data date unspecified, so it likely reflects higher-flow heads than today's Ecolabel 6-8 L/min.

coefficients.condition: One shower a person a day, at 60 to 80 litres each (the French water agencies' figure, from 2012). A water-saving head uses less.
coefficients.condition_fr: Une douche par personne et par jour, à 60 à 80 litres chacune (le chiffre des Agences de l’eau, de 2012). Un pommeau économe en consomme moins.
coefficients.source: Agences de l'Eau, Les economies d'eau, via Office International de l'Eau
coefficients.notes: SECOND BASIS for a quantity that already has one, deliberately. The two constructions of household shower use disagree, and the union rule exists so the reader sees that uncertainty rather than an editorial pick they cannot audit. | Condition as first written: one shower per person per day at the Agences de l'Eau figure of 60-80 L per shower. A PUBLISHED per-person-per-day quantity rather than a product of flow rate x duration x frequency, which is the form that compounds uncertainty. Source sheet published 2012, data date unspecified, so it likely reflects higher-flow heads than today's Ecolabel 6-8 L/min.

coefficients.condition: Efficiency averaged over the loads an inverter really runs at, most of the time below full power. The 98% often quoted is its best moment.
coefficients.condition_fr: Le rendement moyen sur les charges auxquelles un onduleur tourne vraiment, le plus souvent sous sa pleine puissance. Les 98 % souvent cités sont son meilleur moment.
coefficients.source: EN 50530 defines the metric; the figures read from secondary commercial sources
coefficients.notes: TIER C, UPGRADE BY READING A DATASHEET OR THE STANDARD. Vendor sources have an obvious incentive on this number (protocol para 3). The metric itself is a mandated test method, which is why the range is narrow, but narrow is not the same as verified. | Condition as first written: EUROPEAN EFFICIENCY, the power-weighted figure defined by EN 50530, NOT peak efficiency: peak runs 98-98.5 pc and is the number marketing quotes. The European weighting exists because a panel spends most of its life at part load.

coefficients.condition: What comes back out for what went in, over a full charge and discharge, for lead-acid batteries. Old or hot batteries sit at the low end.
coefficients.condition_fr: Ce qui ressort pour ce qui est entré, sur une charge et une décharge complètes, pour des batteries au plomb. Les batteries anciennes ou au chaud sont dans le bas de l’échelle.
coefficients.source: Solar and battery industry comparison sites, consistent across several independent vendors (already catalogued as Tier C in Sources-and-References.md)
coefficients.notes: The project's existing stance on exactly these sources: broadly consistent across vendors, usable as indicative ranges, not lab-verified until a Tier A/B source is read. | Condition as first written: ROUND-TRIP: energy out divided by energy in over a full charge and discharge, not a one-way figure. Lead-acid; the low end reflects older or hotter installations.

coefficients.condition: What comes back out for what went in, over a full charge and discharge.
coefficients.condition_fr: Ce qui ressort pour ce qui est entré, sur une charge et une décharge complètes.
coefficients.source: Solar and battery industry comparison sites, consistent across several independent vendors (already catalogued as Tier C in Sources-and-References.md)
coefficients.notes: Same caveat as the lead-acid row. The gap between the two chemistries, roughly 10-20 points of round-trip loss, is the decision-relevant part and is agreed across sources. | Condition as first written: ROUND-TRIP over a full charge and discharge cycle. LiFePO4 with an integrated BMS.

coefficients.condition: Efficiency over a heating season, as the European rules measure it. The "over 100%" in adverts is measured another way and is not comparable. 86% is the legal minimum.
coefficients.condition_fr: Le rendement sur une saison de chauffe, tel que les règles européennes le mesurent. Les « plus de 100 % » des publicités sont mesurés autrement et ne sont pas comparables. 86 % est le minimum légal.
coefficients.source: Commission Regulation (EU) No 813/2013 (ecodesign, space heaters)
coefficients.notes: Only the 0.86 floor is regulatory; 0.94 is the practical ceiling for a good condensing unit and is NOT separately sourced. Narrow the upper end when a datasheet or the EPREL database is read. | Condition as first written: SEASONAL space heating energy efficiency as defined by Reg 813/2013, which includes auxiliary electricity and control corrections. It is NOT the >100 pc figure manufacturers advertise: that one is measured against the NET calorific value (PCI), which ignores the latent heat a condensing boiler exists to recover, so the two numbers are not comparable and the marketing one is not wrong, just measured differently. 0.86 is the REGULATORY FLOOR, high enough that a non-condensing boiler cannot meet it.

coefficients.condition: From the least efficient lamp still allowed on sale (85 lumens per watt) to a class A lamp (210).
coefficients.condition_fr: De la lampe la moins efficace encore autorisée à la vente (85 lumens par watt) à une lampe de classe A (210).
coefficients.source: Commission Regulation (EU) 2019/2020 (ecodesign, light sources) and the energy label classes in Reg (EU) 2019/2015
coefficients.notes: RECORDED, NOT SUMMED: this converts electricity into daylight, and nothing else in the catalogue is measured in lumens, so it can never join a total. Kept because it is the figure that decides whether a lamp is worth buying. | Condition as first written: 85 lm/W is the floor to be placed on the EU market at all since September 2021; class A begins at 210. A 2.5x span, so P3.

coefficients.condition: Measured on the standard test, across every size of pan. The top is the legal limit; the bottom is a typical induction hob.
coefficients.condition_fr: Mesurée sur l’essai normalisé, pour toutes les tailles de casserole. Le haut est la limite légale ; le bas, une plaque à induction courante.
coefficients.source: Commission Regulation (EU) No 66/2014 (ecodesign, domestic ovens, hobs and range hoods)
coefficients.notes: RECORDED, NOT SUMMED. Converting Wh/kg into an efficiency needs the test's temperature rise and cookware assumptions, which were not read: a naive conversion lands near 33 pc against induction's commonly quoted ~85 pc pan efficiency, and that gap is proof the conversion is unsafe rather than a finding about induction. UPGRADE by reading the test method, or by taking pan efficiency from a source that states it as a ratio. | Condition as first written: ECelectric hob under the standardised test in Reg 66/2014, measured across all cookware pieces. The upper end is the ecodesign limit; the lower end is typical for induction and is NOT separately sourced.

coefficients.condition: Electricity becomes heat with no loss; what little is lost is the heat the tank gives off when it waits.
coefficients.condition_fr: L’électricité devient de la chaleur sans perte ; le peu qui se perd, c’est la chaleur que le ballon dégage en attendant d’être utilisé.
coefficients.source: Physical definition for the element; standing loss is regulated as parameter S in Commission Regulation (EU) No 814/2013
coefficients.notes: The primary-vs-delivered trap on this row is the reason the sourcing pass refused it before the split: a number that looks authoritative because it comes from a regulation, and is 2.5x wrong for our purposes. | Condition as first written: DELIVERED energy, not primary. A resistance element converts electricity to heat at 1.00 by definition; the only loss is the tank's standing loss, which is what the range covers. NOT the regulation's published water-heating efficiency for this technology, which is about 0.40 because it is divided by a primary-energy conversion coefficient of 2.5 -- using that figure here would understate the appliance by 2.5x.

coefficients.condition: Hot water delivered for each unit of electricity. It depends on the air it draws from: in an unheated garage in January, it sits at the bottom of the range.
coefficients.condition_fr: L’eau chaude fournie pour chaque unité d’électricité. Elle dépend de l’air où elle puise : dans un garage non chauffé en janvier, on sera dans le bas de l’échelle.
coefficients.source: Commission Regulation (EU) No 814/2013 (ecodesign, water heaters) and the load-profile method it defines
coefficients.notes: Stated as DELIVERED heat per delivered kWh, deliberately not as the regulation's primary-energy water-heating efficiency, for the same reason as the resistive row. UPGRADE by reading the load-profile tables to pin the range per profile. | Condition as first written: COP for DOMESTIC HOT WATER, which is lower than the same machine's space-heating COP because it lifts water to 50-55 degC rather than to a radiator temperature. Depends on the temperature of the air it draws from, so a unit in an unheated garage in January sits at the bottom of this range.

coefficients.condition: A year's use: a box runs day and night, whatever you do with it, and uses about as much as a fridge (ADEME).
coefficients.condition_fr: Sur une année : une box tourne jour et nuit, quoi qu’on en fasse, et consomme à peu près autant qu’un réfrigérateur (ADEME).
coefficients.source: ADEME, as reported by French energy retailers and comparison sites
coefficients.notes: TIER C: the figure is attributed to ADEME throughout but was read from secondary commercial sources, not from an ADEME publication. Upgrade by finding the primary. | Condition as first written: An internet box runs 24 hours a day, which is why an ANNUAL figure is meaningful for it and not for an intermittent appliance: the number barely depends on how much anyone uses it. ADEME's comparison is that a box consumes about as much as a fridge.

coefficients.condition: A year's use: a router runs day and night, about as much as an internet box, or a fridge.
coefficients.condition_fr: Sur une année : un routeur tourne jour et nuit, à peu près comme une box internet, ou un réfrigérateur.
coefficients.source: ADEME, as reported by French energy retailers and comparison sites
coefficients.notes: Same source and same caveat as the fibre row. | Condition as first written: An internet box runs 24 hours a day, which is why an ANNUAL figure is meaningful for it and not for an intermittent appliance: the number barely depends on how much anyone uses it. ADEME's comparison is that a box consumes about as much as a fridge. A cellular router is in the same band as a fibre box.

coefficients.condition: At 40 strokes a minute, someone pumping steadily, with the water 12 to 45 m down. Less from deeper water, and less as the person tires.
coefficients.condition_fr: À 40 coups par minute, quelqu’un qui pompe régulièrement, l’eau étant à 12 à 45 m. Moins si l’eau est plus profonde, et moins quand on se fatigue.
coefficients.source: RWSN public-domain handpump documentation and manufacturer specifications for the Afridev and India Mark II
coefficients.notes: CORRECTS the Stage 0 probe's claim of 35 L/min at 10 m, which is roughly double what either standard pump is rated at and was not corroborated. Third Stage 0 figure found overstated on checking. The narrow 16.5-17.0 band is the two RATED points, not the real spread: a hand pump's real limit is the person, not the pump. RECORDED, NOT SUMMED: a rate per minute becomes a daily quantity only with a duration, and for a hand pump that duration is how long a person is willing to pump. No published figure for that was found, and inventing one would put a guess where a source belongs. The rated output is real and is shown. | Condition as first written: RATED output AT 40 STROKES PER MINUTE, which is a person working steadily. Afridev is rated 16.5 L/min at a static water level of 20-45 m; India Mark II 17 L/min at 12-33 m. The delivered rate falls as head increases and as whoever is pumping tires, so this is a rated figure and not a sustained household output.

coefficients.condition: Efficiency over a heating season, from the legal minimum (65%) to a 7-star Flamme Verte stove. Damp wood gives about half the heat of dry wood.
coefficients.condition_fr: Le rendement sur une saison de chauffe, du minimum légal (65 %) à un poêle Flamme Verte 7 étoiles. Du bois humide donne environ moitié moins de chaleur que du bois sec.
coefficients.source: Commission Regulation (EU) 2015/1185 (ecodesign, solid fuel local space heaters)
coefficients.notes: Applies to a MANUFACTURED closed-fronted appliance, which is what this row describes. | Condition as first written: SEASONAL space heating energy efficiency as the regulation defines it, which carries corrections for controls and is not a bench figure. 0.65 is the floor to be placed on the EU market since 1 January 2022; a pellet appliance must reach 0.79. The upper end here is Flamme Verte 7-star territory and is NOT separately sourced.
